script.thesis: Belonging is sitting down without waiting to be poured, not looking invited.

anchor_object.name: untouched drink
anchor_object.initial_state: full, left at the edge of the table

script.monologue: Stay. Sit. Remain. Belonging is not granted. But the drink sits full, unused. You stand at the table's edge. Stay even if no one pours first. Even then you lift the drink yourself. You walk the picnic edge now. Since you walked, you hold the drink. The drink you lifted sits empty. You remain at the table.
